description: Create a file, or a directory with `dir: true`, in the installed plugin's file tree, creating missing parents. File content is inline, at most 50000 characters; directories have no content. `pluginId` targets another plugin of the project instead of the installed one.

dir.description: Create a directory instead of a file (CLI: --dir).

path.description: Path of the new file or directory.

pluginId.description: Id of the plugin to act on (see plugins_list); the installed plugin if omitted (CLI: --plugin-id).

summary.description: Short summary of the file or directory.

name: plugins_files_create
title: Create plugin file
